E2F01792:EE:00B80090.description: Freecam toggle button combination — hold all selected buttons simultaneously
E2F01792:EE:00B80090.notes:
Toggle freecam using the selected button combination (press all buttons simultaneously).
When freecam is active:
  • Left analog stick — pan camera (strafe left/right/forward/back)
  • Right analog stick — rotate / tilt camera direction
  • Circle (○)    — move forward in camera facing direction
  • Square (□)    — move backward in camera facing direction
  • Cross (✕)     — descend (move camera down)
  • Triangle (△) — ascend (move camera up)
Press the same combination again to exit freecam and return to normal gameplay.
⚠ Address is research-estimated. Verify with PCSX2 debugger / memory search before use.

── SCE Pad Bitmask Compatibility ──
This game uses the standard Sony SCE libpad library with the normalized
pressed=1 convention, which means:
  ✅ PNACH static writes to camera-mode addresses are supported
  ✅ Button bitmask combo values (L3+R3, L1+L2, etc.) are valid
  ℹ PNACH codes write a FIXED value to memory — they do NOT hook real-time
     input.  To make freecam toggleable via a button press in-game you need
     a conditional (type-C) PNACH code or a separate cheats engine.
  ⚠ Memory address is research-estimated — verify with PCSX2 debugger
     (Debug → Memory Search) before using in production.

── How to use this code ──
In the PNACH Code Builder, select this entry and choose a button combination
from the Combo dropdown.  The builder writes the bitmask value you choose
into the freecam toggle address.  Because PNACH is a static memory writer,
this 'enables' freecam by locking the camera-mode variable at the chosen
value.  To 'disable', load a different PNACH with value 0x00000000.
A proper in-game toggle requires a conditional PNACH (type C) referencing
the live pad bitmask address — advanced use only.

Toggle freecam using the selected button combination (press all buttons simultaneously).
When freecam is active:
  • Left analog stick — pan camera (strafe left/right/forward/back)
  • Right analog stick — rotate / tilt camera direction
  • Circle (○)    — move forward in camera facing direction
  • Square (□)    — move backward in camera facing direction
  • Cross (✕)     — descend (move camera down)
  • Triangle (△) — ascend (move camera up)
Press the same combination again to exit freecam and return to normal gameplay.
⚠ Address is research-estimated. Verify with PCSX2 debugger / memory search before use.

── SCE Pad Bitmask Compatibility ──
This game uses the standard Sony SCE libpad library with the normalized
pressed=1 convention, which means:
  ✅ PNACH static writes to camera-mode addresses are supported
  ✅ Button bitmask combo values (L3+R3, L1+L2, etc.) are valid
  ℹ PNACH codes write a FIXED value to memory — they do NOT hook real-time
     input.  To make freecam toggleable via a button press in-game you need
     a conditional (type-C) PNACH code or a separate cheats engine.
  ⚠ Memory address is research-estimated — verify with PCSX2 debugger
     (Debug → Memory Search) before using in production.

── How to use this code ──
In the PNACH Code Builder, select this entry and choose a button combination
from the Combo dropdown.  The builder writes the bitmask value you choose
into the freecam toggle address.  Because PNACH is a static memory writer,
this 'enables' freecam by locking the camera-mode variable at the chosen
value.  To 'disable', load a different PNACH with value 0x00000000.
A proper in-game toggle requires a conditional PNACH (type C) referencing
the live pad bitmask address — advanced use only.

DA5CC7A3:EE:00830064.description: Freecam toggle button combination — hold all selected buttons simultaneously
DA5CC7A3:EE:00830064.notes:
Toggle freecam using the selected button combination (press all buttons simultaneously).
When freecam is active:
  • Left analog stick — pan camera (strafe left/right/forward/back)
  • Right analog stick — rotate / tilt camera direction
  • Circle (○)    — move forward in camera facing direction
  • Square (□)    — move backward in camera facing direction
  • Cross (✕)     — descend (move camera down)
  • Triangle (△) — ascend (move camera up)
Press the same combination again to exit freecam and return to normal gameplay.
⚠ Address is research-estimated. Verify with PCSX2 debugger / memory search before use.

── SCE Pad Bitmask Compatibility ──
This game uses the standard Sony SCE libpad library with the normalized
pressed=1 convention, which means:
  ✅ PNACH static writes to camera-mode addresses are supported
  ✅ Button bitmask combo values (L3+R3, L1+L2, etc.) are valid
  ℹ PNACH codes write a FIXED value to memory — they do NOT hook real-time
     input.  To make freecam toggleable via a button press in-game you need
     a conditional (type-C) PNACH code or a separate cheats engine.
  ⚠ Memory address is research-estimated — verify with PCSX2 debugger
     (Debug → Memory Search) before using in production.

── How to use this code ──
In the PNACH Code Builder, select this entry and choose a button combination
from the Combo dropdown.  The builder writes the bitmask value you choose
into the freecam toggle address.  Because PNACH is a static memory writer,
this 'enables' freecam by locking the camera-mode variable at the chosen
value.  To 'disable', load a different PNACH with value 0x00000000.
A proper in-game toggle requires a conditional PNACH (type C) referencing
the live pad bitmask address — advanced use only.
